Indicates whether the given view should be cached.
The name and locale used to resolve the view are also provided.
items.translation:
指示是否应缓存给定的视图。
用于解析视图的名称和区域设置也已提供。

items.source: viewName - the name used to resolve the view
locale - the locale used to resolve the view
items.translation: locale - 用于解析 view 的区域设置

items.source: true if the view should be cached; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示应缓存视图；否则为 false。
